relations.text: BetMGM北米合弁の提携先で、主要な意思決定は双方の同意が必要である
relations.text_en: Venture partner in BetMGM North America Venture, with major activities requiring consent of both members

source.label: MGM Resorts 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: For example, we share control of BetMGM North America Venture with our venture partner, Entain plc (“Entain”), with all major operating, investing and financial activities requiring the consent of both members.

relations.text: VICIとの間で改訂版のマスターリース契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: MGM entered into an amended and restated master lease with VICI

source.label: MGM Resorts 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We entered into an amended and restated master lease with VICI. See Note 11 for discussion of the lease.

relations.text: 2021年12月にオリックスとMGM大阪を設立し、統合型リゾートの開発を計画している
relations.text_en: In December 2021, MGM and ORIX formed the MGM Osaka venture to develop the integrated resort

source.label: MGM Resorts 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In December 2021, we and ORIX formed a venture, MGM Osaka, through which we plan to develop the integrated resort.
